title: Faithbreaker

sources.title: Absolute Power
markers: | summary = '''Absolute Power''' is a [[weapon action]] granted by {{SmRarityItem|Faithbreaker}} that deals additional {{DamageType|Force}} damage and pushes targets away.

summary: A +1 warhammer with Absolute Power, a short-rest melee attack that adds 1d6 Force and can push the target.

fields.Absolute Power: Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee weapon attack for weapon damage with an additional Strength modifier and 1d6 Force. A Strength save against your spell save DC negates the roughly 16 ft push. The save does not negate the damage.
fields.Base value: 300 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
